purpose: Define shared identifiers, Scope/Feature composition, references, provenance, rights and lifecycle without using historical LOC1–8 identifiers as Current ownership or architecture keys.
current_architecture: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition

system_id.description: Canonical language-system identifier. Current system instance: lo3rwang.

scope_id.description: Governed data and authority boundary for this record. Scope identifiers are instance-specific and mutable under Current Governance; this schema does not freeze a universal scope list.

feature_ids.description: Reusable capabilities that consume the record's Scope without taking ownership of it. Feature assignment does not redefine Scope authority.

page_composition_refs.description: Optional UI/page projections that compose this Scope with Features. Page composition is a consumer projection, not Canon authority.

era_id.description: Reference to the Current ERA registry when the record has a governed temporal classification.

work_id.description: Stable cross-media work identifier when the record belongs to a work.

media_id.description: Stable media-asset identifier when the record references a media asset.

source_refs.description: References to source files, events, works, media, URLs, registries or other evidence without duplicating their canonical content.

provenance.description: Evidence lineage. Historical LOC1–8 identifiers may be preserved here only as provenance and never become Current ownership or architecture.

content_type.description: Shared routing/display type describing what the record is, independent from Scope authority and Feature composition.

entity_id.description: Optional stable entity identifier when a record is not primarily a work/media/event.

governance.description: Optional shared governance envelope. Domain records may reference a separate governance-event log rather than embedding full history.

domain.description: Legacy semantic-domain compatibility field. It may describe old routing but cannot define Current Scope, Feature ownership or Canon authority.

primary_loc.description: Historical compatibility only. A LOC1–8 value here is provenance and must never be interpreted as Current ownership.

related_locs.description: Historical compatibility only. Do not add to new Current records.

governance_rules: Current architecture is Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition.

LOC1–8 may appear only as explicitly Historical/provenance identifiers or compatibility evidence; they cannot define Current architecture, Scope, Feature ownership, navigation taxonomy or Canon authority.
New Current records use scope_id and feature_ids. Scope authority and Feature capability are separate concerns.
Scopes are governed, mutable and instance-specific; no permanent universal scope list is defined by this schema.
Features consume a Scope without taking ownership of it.
Generated data, Search, RAG and UI are projections/consumers and never create governance authority.
Original evidence and current interpretation are separate layers; later interpretation must not silently rewrite historical source records.
NAV is a Frozen Interface and is outside this schema's write authority.
